# mass and motion term separately as well as the atmospheric
# excitation function of the Earth rotation.
# 
# The atmospheric angular momentum was computed by integration
# of the 3D model of distribution of air density and wind speed
# derived from the output of the numerical weather model
# Mass term was computed using both an inverted barometer and 
# non-inverted barometer hypotheses.
# 
# The variant with the non-inverted barometer hypothesis invoked
# means that the change of the sea level height induced 
# by atmospheric pressure change was ignored
# 
# The variant with the inverted barometer hypothesis invoked
# means that the reaction of the sea level height induced
# by atmospheric pressure change complete counerbalances
# the atmospheric pressure and as a results the bottom pressure that
# is the some of the atmospheric pressure and the sea column pressure
# is constant. The mass term over the ocean was excluded from integration
# 
# Therefore, the mass term with the inverted barometer hypothesis invoked
# is computed by integrarging only over the land. The mass term with the 
# non-inverted barometer hypothesis invoked # is computed by integrarging
# over entire Earth that includes both land and sea.
